feed.title: The week in free proxies
feed.subtitle: How long free proxies last and which sites let them through – from hourly checks by proxy-scraper

entry.title: The week in free proxies: Sep 25 – Sep 28, 2026
entry.content:
20,255 different proxies passed every check at least once. Of the 19,228 that dropped off again, 88 % were gone by the next check, and only 3 (under 0.1 %) made it through 24 checks in a row (about a day) or more. 102 proxies on the list right now have been up for 24 checks in a row or more.
Google let 48 % through – 41 % of datacenter exits, 54 % of the rest.
Reddit let 54 % through – 24 % of datacenter exits, 91 % of the rest.
Amazon let 35 % through – 33 % of datacenter exits, 40 % of the rest.
Instagram let 39 % through – 21 % of datacenter exits, 62 % of the rest.
TikTok let 62 % through – 78 % of datacenter exits, 42 % of the rest.
Between 888 and 4,223 proxies worked at any one time. Right now: 1,026, 46 % of them tunnel HTTPS, 45 % exit from a datacenter.
Downloading 100 KB through them: half manage 80 KiB/s or more, the fastest tenth over 129 KiB/s.
Most of them sit in United States (317), China (152), Germany (44), Netherlands (43), France (33).
